rationale: David's work optimizing ML inference for edge environments complements Syed's robotics and real-time systems expertise—edge AI inference is critical infrastructure for autonomous systems like those at Boston Dynamics. Both work at the intersection of performance-constrained AI and systems-level optimization, with overlapping technical depth in Python and systems programming, making them valuable sounding boards on the challenges of deploying ML at the edge.
intro_message: David Venegas, meet Syed Mohammad Asjad — you're both solving the hard systems problems at the intersection of ML inference and resource-constrained environments, from different angles.
